admin_audit_log_target_check.name: admin_audit_log_target_check
admin_audit_log_target_check.value: ("core"."admin_audit_log"."target_type" is null or "core"."admin_audit_log"."target_type" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,39}$') and ("core"."admin_audit_log"."target_id" is null or "core"."admin_audit_log"."target_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$')

coupons_limits_check.name: coupons_limits_check
coupons_limits_check.value: ("core"."coupons"."max_redemptions" is null or "core"."coupons"."max_redemptions" between 1 and 1000000) and "core"."coupons"."per_workspace_limit" between 1 and 100 and "core"."coupons"."redemption_count" >= 0

plans_amounts_check.name: plans_amounts_check
plans_amounts_check.value: "core"."plans"."price_vnd" between 0 and 1000000000 and "core"."plans"."channels_limit" >= 0 and "core"."plans"."monthly_turns" between 0 and 1000000

plans_trial_days_check.name: plans_trial_days_check
plans_trial_days_check.value: ("core"."plans"."kind" = 'trial') = ("core"."plans"."trial_days" is not null) and ("core"."plans"."trial_days" is null or "core"."plans"."trial_days" between 1 and 90)

invoices_transfer_code_check.name: invoices_transfer_code_check
invoices_transfer_code_check.value: "core"."invoices"."transfer_code" ~ '^(CF|XF)[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{8}$' and left("core"."invoices"."transfer_code", 2) = case "core"."invoices"."product" when 'commentflow' then 'CF' else 'XF' end

invoices_state_check.name: invoices_state_check
invoices_state_check.value: ("core"."invoices"."status" = 'paid') = ("core"."invoices"."paid_at" is not null) and ("core"."invoices"."status" = 'void') = ("core"."invoices"."voided_at" is not null)

workspace_deletion_requests_state_check.name: workspace_deletion_requests_state_check
workspace_deletion_requests_state_check.value:
("core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."status" <> 'scheduled' or ("core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."confirmed_at" is not null and "core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."execute_after" is not null))
        and ("core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."status" <> 'completed' or "core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "core"."workspace_deletion_requests"."cancelled_at" is not null)

abbreviations_short_check.name: abbreviations_short_check
abbreviations_short_check.value: "cf"."abbreviations"."short" = lower("cf"."abbreviations"."short") and "cf"."abbreviations"."short" !~ '\s' and char_length("cf"."abbreviations"."short") between 1 and 32

comments_attachments_shape_check.name: comments_attachments_shape_check
comments_attachments_shape_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("cf"."comments"."attachments") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("cf"."comments"."attachments") <= 10 else false end

kb_chunks_embedding_hnsw_idx.name: kb_chunks_embedding_hnsw_idx
kb_chunks_embedding_hnsw_idx.where: "cf"."kb_chunks"."embedding" is not null and not "cf"."kb_chunks"."is_draft" and not "cf"."kb_chunks"."injection_suspected"

kb_chunks_valid_range_check.name: kb_chunks_valid_range_check
kb_chunks_valid_range_check.value: "cf"."kb_chunks"."valid_from" is null or "cf"."kb_chunks"."valid_until" is null or "cf"."kb_chunks"."valid_until" > "cf"."kb_chunks"."valid_from"

kb_sources_external_key_unique.name: kb_sources_external_key_unique
kb_sources_external_key_unique.where: "cf"."kb_sources"."external_key" is not null and "cf"."kb_sources"."deleted_at" is null

leads_contact_shape_check.name: leads_contact_shape_check
leads_contact_shape_check.value:
("cf"."leads"."phone_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "cf"."leads"."phone_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cf"."leads"."phone_last4" IS NOT NULL
        OR "cf"."leads"."phone_enc" IS NULL AND "cf"."leads"."phone_hash" IS NULL AND "cf"."leads"."phone_last4" IS NULL)
        AND ("cf"."leads"."email_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "cf"."leads"."email_hash" IS NOT NULL
        OR "cf"."leads"."email_enc" IS NULL AND "cf"."leads"."email_hash" IS NULL)
        AND ("cf"."leads"."phone_enc" IS NOT NULL OR "cf"."leads"."email_enc" IS NOT NULL)

retrieval_logs_text_check.name: retrieval_logs_text_check
retrieval_logs_text_check.value: char_length("cf"."retrieval_logs"."query_masked") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND ("cf"."retrieval_logs"."search_query_masked" IS NULL OR char_length("cf"."retrieval_logs"."search_query_masked") <= 500)

size_charts_category_check.name: size_charts_category_check
size_charts_category_check.value: "cf"."size_charts"."category_norm" IS NULL OR (char_length("cf"."size_charts"."category") between 1 and 100 AND char_length("cf"."size_charts"."category_norm") between 1 and 100)

size_charts_range_check.name: size_charts_range_check
size_charts_range_check.value:
num_nonnulls("cf"."size_charts"."height_min_cm", "cf"."size_charts"."height_max_cm", "cf"."size_charts"."weight_min_kg", "cf"."size_charts"."weight_max_kg") >= 1
        AND coalesce("cf"."size_charts"."height_min_cm", 1) > 0 AND coalesce("cf"."size_charts"."height_max_cm", 1) > 0
        AND coalesce("cf"."size_charts"."weight_min_kg", 1) > 0 AND coalesce("cf"."size_charts"."weight_max_kg", 1) > 0
        AND ("cf"."size_charts"."height_min_cm" IS NULL OR "cf"."size_charts"."height_max_cm" IS NULL OR "cf"."size_charts"."height_min_cm" <= "cf"."size_charts"."height_max_cm")
        AND ("cf"."size_charts"."weight_min_kg" IS NULL OR "cf"."size_charts"."weight_max_kg" IS NULL OR "cf"."size_charts"."weight_min_kg" <= "cf"."size_charts"."weight_max_kg")

rules_pattern_shape_check.name: rules_pattern_shape_check
rules_pattern_shape_check.value: ("cf"."rules"."type" IN ('keyword', 'regex') AND "cf"."rules"."pattern" <> '') OR ("cf"."rules"."type" NOT IN ('keyword', 'regex') AND "cf"."rules"."pattern" = '')
